description: Validate WoW interface XML against Blizzard's own UI.xsd: unknown or misspelled elements and attributes, invalid nesting, bad enum values, and structural mistakes like a virtual frame with no name. Run this on every XML file an addon loads — the client silently ignores what it does not understand, so these mistakes are otherwise invisible.

path.description: Path to a .xml file to validate.

name: wow_xml_validate
title: Validate interface XML
